grey_health_design.problem: Pyke P, Rengar W, Tahm Kench E, Mordekaiser W, Kled heal from damage TAKEN (post-mitigation) stored as grey health; the 1v1 healing derivation only sees the attacker's OUTGOING events.
grey_health_design.design: Author grey-health receipts in participant_timeline.py's incoming ledger: when the main is the defender and is a grey-health champion, accumulate 100%/50% (per champion) of post-mitigation incoming damage as grey health; pay it as a heal when the champion's active consumes it (Pyke P out-of-vision, Rengar W recast, Tahm K E, Mordekaiser W recast). Add a shared primitive (grey_health_store) keyed by participant.
grey_health_design.dependency: after E1 (heal rules landed) — the grey-health heals will call the same _heal_from_damage/later_target plumbing.
grey_health_design.test: enemy attacks main for known post-mitigation damage -> grey-health champion's stored grey + heal on consume match wiki ratios.
